title: VELARIUM UPDATE IN PROGRESS
author: Competitive_Might709
selftext:
A quick update on the game I’m building with Claude Code and CODEX.  
The name has changed—it’s now VELARIUM.  
I’ve added the characters I had in mind to the game (everything is currently modeled in Blender).  
I’ve switched to Tripo; the next update will feature new models.

  
There are plenty of updates on the way—I’d love to hear what you think so far.  
Naturally, the sound, modeling, and everything else will continue to improve; my priority was to finalize the game loop first, then see where to go from there.

  
Let me know what else you think I should work on (aside from what I’m already aware of, haha).  
Thanks in advance, everyone!
